fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. Paul says, "…I bow my knees before the Father…" (Ephesians 3:14), and he calls himself an ambassador in chains (Ephesians 6:20) and the prisoner of Christ Jesus (Ephesians 3:1). Whatever his chains were doing, his knees were still free to bow. I think a lot of us could learn from a man who prays from right where he is.
